# Written by corpus_test. Delete this file to re-record after a
# deliberate change to the data set itself.
# Changed 2026-09-18 for issue #33, deliberately, not by re-recording:
# the rekordbox cue writer now keeps the legacy PCOB lists level with
# PCO2, and the reader reads them. rekordbox.cues went 314 -> 317, the
# three hot cues one fixture track carries in its legacy lists alone
# (the other four such tracks hold the same cue in both lists and
# deduplicate). Every durableWritesPerSave that moved gained exactly one
# write per track whose .DAT legacy list changed; sync writes several
# tracks, hence +5 there.
# Changed 2026-09-18 again, deliberately: Engine stores "no main cue" as
# a sample offset of -1, and the reader turned that into a memory cue a
# fraction of a millisecond before the track starts. 1436 of this
# fixture's 1564 tracks had nothing but that phantom, so the numbers here
# were a record of the bug: engine.cues 1688 -> 219, engine.tracksWithCues
# 1561 -> 125. What is left is the cues someone really placed.
engine.cues 219
engine.opensPerBatch 1
engine.tracks 1564
engine.tracksWithAlbum 1563
engine.tracksWithCues 125
engine.writeRefusals 0
matrix.addCue.durableWritesPerSave 4
matrix.addCue.pdbParses 1
matrix.cleanup.durableWritesPerSave 5
matrix.cleanup.pdbParses 2
matrix.copyCues.durableWritesPerSave 4
matrix.deleteOrphan.durableWritesPerSave 2
matrix.deviceSetting.durableWritesPerSave 3
matrix.mergeCues.durableWritesPerSave 4
matrix.repair.durableWritesPerSave 5
matrix.repair.pdbParses 1
matrix.strayCue.durableWritesPerSave 7
matrix.strayCue.encryptedOpensPerSave 1
matrix.strayCue.pdbParsesPerSave 1
matrix.sync.durableWritesPerSave 14
matrix.sync.engineOpens 0
onelibrary.tracks 1644
rekordbox.cues 317

rekordbox.tracksWithCues 222
